description: Use this only when the user asks to undo a change Apptiller made. Puts back, at the user's request, the value an ad account had before Apptiller changed it. Only while the campaign, ad group or keyword still has the value Apptiller wrote: if it was changed since, nothing is written. It changes the live ad account.
name: undo_change
title: Undo a change Apptiller made
